g.title: J2
g.text: Isolated from the controller. Polarity does not matter.

g.title: OPENER
g.text: Unplug the opener first. Use only 1 and 2. Leave the 4-5 bridge in place.

g.title: REED_CLOSED
g.text: Closes when the door is fully closed. Either wire to either side.

g.title: REED_OPEN
g.text: Closes when the door is fully open.
